what_differs: The meetings agreed that the operator/partner IDs loaded so far are a sandbox starting point from Airtable, are not validated, and must be changed in both the CMS and Salesforce before production. WAGR-460 maps only Deal IDs before cutover and leaves Operator/Partner CMS mappings to hypercare. WAGR-20 does not cover operators/partners.
suggested_action: Add a pre-production step (to WAGR-460 or WAGR-20): WagerTech confirms the authoritative active and inactive operator/partner list, Jumpr loads it, and both sides reconcile Operator/Partner External IDs in the CMS and Salesforce before the first production SLC.
